title: MR-JEPA: A General Purpose Video Foundation Model for Cardiac MRI
abstract: arXiv:2608.30975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) produces rich sequential data such as temporal cine videos and spatial LGE/mapping stacks, yet most deep learning approaches process individual 2D slices, discarding this context. We present MR-JEPA, a self-supervised video foundation model for CMR that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs through tubelet tokenization, spatiotemporal masking augmentation, and initialization from a 2D CMR foundation model. Unlike prior CMR video models limited to cine data, MR-JEPA is pretrained on multi-sequence data (cine, LGE, mapping) from 10,505 patients across two centers without annotations. We evaluate the frozen encoder on six downstream tasks using a unified multi-view gated attention architecture: LV ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction, three myocardial strains (GLS, GCS, GRS), and four-class disease detection. translated_title: MR-JEPA：一种用于心脏磁共振成像的通用视频基础模型
translated_abstract: 心脏磁共振成像（CMR）会产生丰富的序列数据，例如时间维度的电影序列视频和空间维度的LGE/映射图像堆栈，然而大多数深度学习方法仅处理单个2D切片，丢弃了这些上下文信息。我们提出了MR-JEPA，一个面向CMR的自监督视频基础模型，它通过管状标记化、时空掩码数据增强以及从2D CMR基础模型初始化，将LeJEPA扩展至3D时空输入。与以往仅限于电影序列数据的CMR视频模型不同，MR-JEPA在来自两个中心、共10,505名患者的多序列数据（电影序列、LGE、映射）上进行了无标注预训练。我们使用统一的多视图门控注意力架构，在六个下游任务上评估冻结编码器：左心室射血分数、右心室射血分数、三种心肌应变（GLS、GCS、GRS）以及四类疾病检测。MR-JEPA在全部五个回归任务上均优于其他对比方法，包括……
tldr: MR-JEPA是一种面向心脏磁共振的自监督视频基础模型，通过将LeJEPA扩展到3D时空输入并在无标注多序列CMR数据上预训练，在射血分数、心肌应变和疾病检测等多项下游任务上均取得最优性能。
en_tdlr: MR-JEPA is a self-supervised video foundation model for cardiac MRI that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs, pretrained on multi-sequence CMR data without annotations, and outperforms prior methods on downstream tasks including ejection fraction regression, myocardial strain estimation, and disease detection.
